snippet.title: Minishoot' Adventures - Console Versions Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Minishoot' Adventures is now available to play, not only on PC, but also on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series and Microsoft Store PC with Game Pass

Fly into a charming handcrafted world and go on an adventure that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action. Fight your way from the shiny overworld to the deepest caves, improve your ship and overcome the dungeons' bosses to rescue your friends!

❤️ Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-Edition/Minishoot-Adventures-Nintendo-Switch-2-Edition-3037912.html?s=countries
💙 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012421
💚 Xbox: https://xbox.com/en-US/games/store/minishoot-adventure/9N5PKH0KW2L1
